scientific limitations/integrity.domain: Compactly supported invariant Borel probability measures inside \((0,\infty)^3\) for the classical deterministic May–Leonard flow on \(\alpha+\beta=2\), \(\alpha\ne1\).
scientific limitations/integrity.limits: No claim for boundary-supported measures, \(\alpha=1\), stochastic/spatial/delayed variants, or exhaustive classification of invariant measures.
scientific limitations/integrity.literature_risk: A highly relevant 2013 global-dynamics paper was compared through its repository abstract and metadata, but its full body was not reliably obtained; this leaves a residual coverage risk.
scientific limitations/integrity.proof_integrity: The theorem is analytic. The bundled symbolic checker verifies algebraic reductions only and is not treated as a proof of the invariant-measure steps.

title: Universal \(-1/2\) pairwise correlation on the critical May–Leonard cycle family
